D: Logan's past, from his brother Victor to the Weapon X program.
P: Serve the mains when the kind old farm couple feed Logan breakfast.
S: Logan's quiet life working as a lumberjack in Canada
Thick chips cooked twice until crisp, piled into bowls, scattered with torn mozzarella and covered in hot beef gravy so the cheese melts.
the logging camp in the Rockies
Medjool dates wrapped in half rashers of bacon, held with toothpicks and baked at 200C for 15 minutes until crisp and sticky.
the Canadian forest where Logan lives with Kayla
Pecans tossed with maple syrup and salt, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes, cooled on baking paper until crunchy.
M: the elderly farm couple who take Logan in
Buttermilk pancakes, fried eggs and crisp bacon on one big plate, drowned in maple syrup, the full farmhouse breakfast.
Rib eye seared hard and butter basted with garlic, rested and served with crispy roast potatoes and greens.
W: Maple syrup whisked with eggs and cream, poured into a blind-baked shortcrust shell, baked at 170C for 40 minutes until just set.
K: Logan and his beer at the end of a shift
Cold lager in frosted glasses, or ginger beer for the non-drinkers.

s.note: Logan's quiet life working as a lumberjack in Canada
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry twice until crisp. Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, then whisk in 500ml beef stock and simmer until thick. Pile chips into bowls, scatter with torn mozzarella and pour over the hot gravy.

s.note: the logging camp in the Rockies
s.how: Cut 8 rashers of bacon in half. Wrap each half around a pitted medjool date and secure with a toothpick. Lay on a lined tray and bake at 200C for 15 minutes, turning once, until the bacon is crisp and the dates are sticky.

m.note: the elderly farm couple who take Logan in
m.how: Whisk 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs and 375ml buttermilk into a batter and cook pancakes in butter. Fry 8 rashers of bacon and 4 eggs. Pile it all on one big plate and drown it in maple syrup.

w.how: Blind bake a shortcrust case. Whisk 250ml maple syrup with 3 eggs and 200ml cream until smooth. Pour into the case and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until just set with a slight wobble. Cool completely before slicing.

d.note: Logan and his beer at the end of a shift
d.how: Put glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes until frosted. Pour cold lager for the drinkers and ginger beer for everyone else. Drink it in a roadside bar somewhere in the Canadian Rockies, looking moody.
